title: Update your Subscription
content: A lot of people have emailed me saying that they had signed up for an email subscription to GurneyJourney but that the subscription was interrupted.I'm not sure why this happened, but I've added a new "Subscribe" widget in the column at left so that you can sign up with any of the web-based newsreaders like Yahoo, Feedly, Bloglines, NetVibes, or SubToMe to get the daily blast by email.You can also use a blog reader service likePulse, which lets you organize all your favorite blogs to show you new posts whenever they come up.
